flashcard_questions.a: The precise concentration of an acid or an alkali.

flashcard_questions.q: Which piece of apparatus delivers the acid in a titration?
Which piece of apparatus measures the fixed volume of alkali?
What volume of alkali is typically measured into the conical flask?
What colour change does phenolphthalein show as acid is added to alkali?
What is the end point of a titration?
flashcard_questions.a: The moment the indicator permanently changes colour, showing neutralisation is complete.

flashcard_questions.q: How close must two titres be to count as concordant?
Which titre is always left out of the mean?
Which equation is used to find an unknown concentration from a titration?
What produces the electricity in a chemical cell?
flashcard_questions.a: A chemical reaction between two different metals standing in an electrolyte.

flashcard_questions.q: What makes a chemical cell produce a higher voltage?
flashcard_questions.a: A bigger difference in reactivity between the two metal electrodes.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a battery, in terms of cells?
flashcard_questions.a: Two or more chemical cells connected in series.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the only waste product from a hydrogen fuel cell?
Which equation shows the overall reaction in a hydrogen fuel cell?
Why is hydrogen difficult to use as a vehicle fuel?
flashcard_questions.a: It is highly flammable, so storing and transporting it safely is difficult and expensive.
